# ESG Data Extractor — Python dependencies
#
# Generated by auditing every import across the 90 .py files in this repo and
# pinning to the versions currently installed in ./venv (Python 3.14.6).
#
# Install:  pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# Pins use == to make runs reproducible. To upgrade a package deliberately,
# bump the pin here rather than installing ad hoc, so the venv and this file
# do not drift apart.
#
# Only direct dependencies are listed. Transitive packages (starlette, httpx,
# certifi, urllib3, greenlet, pytz, ...) are resolved automatically by pip and
# are intentionally omitted so this file stays readable and reviewable.


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Web API  —  app.py, api/v1/**
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fastapi==0.138.0                # APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, BackgroundTasks
uvicorn==0.49.0                 # ASGI server that runs app.py
pydantic==2.13.4                # BaseModel request/response schemas (api/v1/**/schema.py)
python-multipart==0.0.32        # form/multipart parsing for FastAPI endpoints


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Database  —  database.py, api/v1/models.py, agentic_estimation/**
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Both drivers are required and neither is redundant:
#   psycopg2  -> sync engine + execute_batch bulk writes (postgresql:// URLs)
#   asyncpg   -> create_async_engine / AsyncSession paths in the agentic layers
SQLAlchemy==2.0.51              # ORM, DeclarativeBase, postgresql dialect insert()
psycopg2-binary==2.9.12         # sync driver; -binary avoids needing a local C toolchain
asyncpg==0.31.0                 # async driver for create_async_engine


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Agentic pipeline  —  agentic_estimation/graph.py, orchestrator.py
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
langgraph==1.2.9                # StateGraph / END — layer 1-4 orchestration graph


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# External ESG / financial data sources  —  api/v1/esg_data/fetchers/**
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
wikirate4py==2.0.8              # WikiRate ESG metrics API client
yfinance==1.4.1                 # Yahoo Finance company financials
requests==2.34.2                # SEC EDGAR, Climate TRACE, and the zen_client LLM calls
ddgs==9.14.4                    # DuckDuckGo search for evidence gathering (signal_agent)
edinet-tools==0.8.4             # Japan EDINET securities-report entity resolution + typed parsing (public_records_collector)
warn-scraper==1.2.143           # US state WARN Act mass-layoff/closure notice scrapers (public_records_collector)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Data processing  —  layer_1/country_baseline_agent.py, layer_2/**, calibration/**
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pandas==3.0.3                   # dataframes; drives the country-baseline workbook loads
numpy==2.5.0                    # numeric work in the estimators and calibration harness
pycountry==26.2.16              # ISO 3166 country database — layer_1/country_normalizer.py.
                                # Offline (no API/rate limit); replaces the
                                # hand-written alias dict that could not cover
                                # the space of incoming country spellings.
openpyxl==3.1.5                 # REQUIRED: pandas.read_excel() backend for .xlsx.
                                # pandas does not depend on it, and the country
                                # baseline / climate-trace anchors fail at runtime
                                # without it. Do not drop this as "unused" — no
                                # source file imports it by name.
scikit-learn==1.9.0             # TF-IDF + k-means evidence clustering —
                                # layer_2/evidence_clusters.py (cluster-severity
                                # labels replace per-claim guessed strength)
sentence-transformers==5.1.2    # MiniLM embeddings — layer_2/evidence_classifier.py's
                                # factor/entity heads, layer_1/evidence_filters.py's
                                # embedding-based relevance check (matches_esg_embedding)
trafilatura==2.1.0              # HTML boilerplate stripping for full-article-body
                                # fetches — layer_1/signal_agent.py's ESG-search sources
                                # (esg_today_search, esgnews_search)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Configuration
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
python-dotenv==1.2.2            # load_dotenv / dotenv_values — reads .env (API keys, DB URL)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Testing  —  tests/**, pytest.ini
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Fast local pass (skips live-DB tests):  pytest -m "not slow"
pytest==9.1.1
